After this page you have a working credential and one call that answered. (Deploying on your own hardware or offline? Jump straight to Self-Hosting & Air-Gapped .) Hanzo is one cloud behind one key. Every capability — inference, identity, storage, money, agents — answers at https://api.hanzo.ai , and the CLI, the SDKs and the MCP tools are all generated from the same description of it. So there is nothing to wire up per service: get a key once and everything is reachable. 1 Install npm Script Homebrew From source npm i -g hanzo Any OS, Windows included.
